How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the sovereign commerce infrastructure leverages a combination of free and paid technologies to establish a seamless online store experience. Using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, along with Google Apps Script for backend logic, the architecture is built on reliable and scalable components. Payment processing is handled through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that creators can receive payments quickly and securely without incurring high fees. The infrastructure also integrates file delivery services to ensure instant access to purchased products, regardless of the creator's location. This architecture not only provides necessary functionality but also creates a robust safety net against the pitfalls of conventional payment systems.

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where major payment platforms are either unavailable or heavily regulated. Countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and Pakistan often find themselves excluded from the digital economy due to these restrictions. COREMERCH recognizes that there are countless talented individuals in these regions looking to sell digital products like stock photos, eBooks, and courses. By focusing on the needs of these creators, COREMERCH empowers them to build their own online businesses without the fear of payment rejections or account suspensions. This solution is for creators who refuse to be sidelined and are ready to take charge of their financial futures.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce infrastructure consists of several key components that work in harmony to create a fluid selling experience. First, it utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, providing a reliable web presence. Order data is managed via Google Sheets or Supabase, allowing creators to easily track sales and manage products. File delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that purchasers can quickly access their digital products. Finally, NOWPayments serves as the payment processor, enabling automatic crypto payment verification with minimal fees. This cohesive setup not only enhances functionality but also ensures that creators retain full ownership of their digital assets, positioning them for long-term success.
